description: Run the 5 CNC machines from released NC programs, printed drawings, and setup sheets; 3 machines receive programs over the network from SYS-03, 2 by USB
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $4,400 of shipments per production day; Prime A and Supplier B on-time delivery ratings; machines keep running programs already loaded for about one shift. Programs saved in the job folders sync to SYS-01 within minutes, so a 4-hour RPO is achievable
manual_workaround: Finish jobs already loaded; hand-load proven programs from the controller memory; run commercial jobs whose programs are already on the machines
dependent_systems: SYS-06; SYS-03 (program transfer); SYS-07; SYS-01 (released programs)
dependent_third_parties: Machine tool service vendor; MSP; internet provider (only for SYS-01 downloads)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Lead Machinist; 2 CNC Machinists; shop floor

description: Import customer models, write CAM and NC programs, prove out first parts, print setup sheets
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New jobs and engineering changes stop, but loaded jobs continue for 2 to 3 days. Only one person can program (key-person dependency). A restored program one revision old could produce nonconforming flight parts, so revisions are checked against the customer drawing before release
manual_workaround: Lead Machinist programs simple 3-axis parts at the machine control; defer new jobs; check every restored program revision against the job folder
dependent_third_parties: Government-community cloud provider; CAM software vendor (license reactivation); MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: CNC Programmer; CAM workstation in the office

description: CMM and manual inspection, first article reports, certificates of conformance, inspection records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Nothing ships without inspection records and a certificate of conformance; primes require objective evidence of conformance for flight parts. Manual gauges cover simple features but not complex 5-axis parts
manual_workaround: Manual inspection with hand gauges and height gauge for simple parts; hold complex parts until the CMM is back; paper inspection reports
dependent_systems: SYS-04 (quality PC and CMM); SYS-01; SYS-07

description: Receive drawing packages and changes from Prime A (portal) and Supplier B (email); send quotes, inspection data, and questions back
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Quote and engineering change deadlines are measured in days. CUI must be exchanged only through approved paths (SYS-01 or the prime portal), never through the commercial suite
manual_workaround: Use the Prime A portal from a clean laptop; phone Supplier B to delay sends; quotes from printed request forms
dependent_third_parties: Government-community cloud provider; Prime A portal; Supplier B; internet provider

business_process: Orders, scheduling, purchasing, shipping, and invoicing
description: Job-shop ERP: order entry, job travelers, purchasing material and outside processing, packing lists, invoices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Shipments need packing lists and certifications; about $21,000 is invoiced per week; the cash reserve covers about 45 days
manual_workaround: Print open-order and traveler reports weekly; handwritten packing lists from the purchase order; invoice when restored
dependent_third_parties: ERP vendor; commercial suite vendor; internet provider

business_process: DoD incident reporting and contract compliance
description: DIBNet cyber incident reports, prime notices, SPRS score and affirmation, export compliance decisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The 72-hour DoD reporting clock (DFARS 252.204-7012(c)) does not stop during an outage. The report must be possible from a clean device that does not depend on the affected systems. Today the company has no medium assurance certificate, so this capability does not exist (P03 G-115)
manual_workaround: Report from a clean laptop or a borrowed clean device with the certificate; phone the Prime A and Supplier B security contacts from the printed list
dependent_systems: Medium assurance certificate (planned); SYS-05 (clean laptop); printed contact list
dependent_third_parties: DoD (DIBNet); Prime A; Supplier B; counsel; cyber insurer

description: Weekly payroll through the payroll service; accounts payable and receivable in the accounting SaaS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll is weekly; a missed payroll harms employees and triggers wage-law issues; the payroll service can repeat the prior payroll
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior week's payroll; manual checks for urgent payables
